services.desc: Exhibits in the King Gallery are co-sponsored by the College of Southern Idaho Art Department and Associated Students of CSI. This schedule is subject to change without notice. The Jean B. King Gallery of Art, in cooperation with the College of Southern Idaho Arts and Humanities Department and the Herrett Center for Arts and Science, offers exhibitions and programs which showcase contemporary art and art issues. The gallery presents national and international exhibitions and supporting programs that expand community awareness of the visual arts while also striving to recognize and promote visual artists residing in Idaho.
